# `time2jd()` {#fn-time2jd}

**Validation on 2.0.9005.** Build 2.0.9005 passed all 499 calendar, clock, era, angle and setting checks in A01. The largest discrepancy across 240 absolute Julian dates was 0.000021 seconds. [A01 results](a01-calendar-checks.qmd).

[Function index](function-index.html#idx-time2jd)

```{=html}
<p>Civil dates require both a calendar and a time convention to specify an instant. The
function parses each supplied date and time, verifies that the calendar date exists by
converting it to a Julian date and back, then applies the chosen offset or civil
timezone to obtain UT. A date without a time uses local midnight. Astronomical year
numbering includes year zero. An era label can also precede the month, for example
<code>"3700 BCE/06/21"</code>.
</p>
<p>Fixed offsets may be numeric hours east of UTC (for example 5.5), or
strings such as <code>"UTC+05:30"</code>, <code>"UTC-02"</code> or <code>"GMT+01"</code>.
Offsets must lie between -14 and +14 hours. UTC, GMT and the empty string
mean zero offset; an empty string does not select the system timezone.
</p>
```

[Civil dates near local midnight](fn-jd2time.qmd).


<details><summary>Implementation arguments, return value and documented modes</summary>

```{=html}
<table><thead><tr><th>Argument</th><th>Formal default</th><th>Behaviour in this interface</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th scope="row"><code>time</code></th><td>—</td><td><p>Character vector in YYYY/MM/DD format, optionally followed by HH:MM or HH:MM:SS. Fractional seconds are accepted. Omitted clock time means midnight.</p></td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><code>timezone</code></th><td>—</td><td><p>Timezone name or fixed offset; defaults to the value in <code>skyscapeR.vars()</code>. See Details.</p></td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><code>calendar</code></th><td>—</td><td><p>Calendar: G or Gregorian, J or Julian. Defaults to the package calendar setting, initially Gregorian.</p></td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><code>verbose</code></th><td><code>F</code></td><td><p>Logical; display a conversion message. Default is FALSE.</p></td></tr></tbody></table><h5>Return value</h5><p>A numeric vector of UT Julian dates, in the same order as time.
</p>
```

</details>

**Implementation.** `R/dates.R`.
